posts.title: Hello World!
posts.content:
I was missing tumblr microblogging (sue me), so I got cursor to build me a mini tumblr to put on my website? (sue me twice!) 
As a relatively recent new grad, a lot of my friends (you guys) are all over the place now. I'm hoping these blogs can be a little piece of the late night beanbag talks we took for granted, no matter where we are now. Maybe it will give you a new book recommendation, a little laugh or a reminder that we are all just silly little humans doing silly little human things that are, lowkey, all the same. Do be nice to me though... I am only 3 years old after all! 
Coming up next: a movie review maybe?!
